assets.prompt: Use-case: product-mockup. Create a premium photorealistic 3D studio campaign image for Pospoint, a modern POS and retail hardware brand. Landscape 3:2 composition, a beautifully designed matte graphite point-of-sale touchscreen terminal on a slim sculptural aluminum pedestal, a compact white and graphite thermal receipt printer with a small blank receipt and a wireless barcode scanner nearby. Three-quarter front view, terminal slightly angled left. Screen shows a tasteful minimalist point-of-sale interface with cobalt blue header, white item tiles, a tiny lime green confirmation circle, no legible text. Devices sit on a low rectangular cobalt blue plinth on a seamless softly lit pale icy blue studio floor and backdrop (#EAF0FC), subtle architectural curves in background. Materials are realistic, sharp bevels, quiet soft directional shadows, premium industrial design, restrained editorial art direction. Equipment fills 75 percent of image and is entirely within frame with breathing room. No people, no logos, no brand lettering, no floating graphic elements, no watermarks. This will be the right-hand visual of a light minimal Georgian ecommerce homepage; match vivid cobalt #2458ED, graphite #141B2D and tiny lime #D9F279 accents.
